steps.en: Install the official client 8.18+ and import the DSL from it (legacy code: swap the old import)
steps.zh: 装官方客户端 8.18+，从它里面导入 DSL（老代码改一下 import）

steps.en: Start a search on a client and index, then chain filters, queries and aggregations
steps.zh: 基于客户端和索引新建搜索，链式追加过滤、查询和聚合

steps.en: Builds query objects by name and composes them into one bool query, filters in filter context
steps.zh: 按名字生成查询对象，合成一个 bool 查询，过滤条件放进 filter 上下文

steps.en: Sends it through the low-level client and wraps the reply so hits and buckets read as attributes
steps.zh: 经底层客户端发出请求，把返回包装成可按属性读取的命中和分桶

value.en: Queries are Python you can refactor, not nested dicts where one misplaced bracket breaks the search
value.zh: 查询成了能重构的 Python 代码，而不是错一个括号就坏掉的嵌套字典

sources: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch-dsl-py#deprecation-notice (8.18.0: part of elasticsearch client; replace elasticsearch_dsl with elasticsearch.dsl)

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch-dsl-py#search-example (Search(using=client, index="my-index"), .filter/.query/.exclude, s.aggs.bucket, response = s.execute(); 'the library took care of' list)
